content.text:
I fixed three bugs in `0.html`, but none of it has been tested in a browser — the shell command I tried for checking browser tooling was denied in this session.

## What changed

1. **Shift+Enter reversed the next mouse click.** Holding Shift+Enter left the "shift held" flag set after the key repeats, so a later plain click cycled backwards. Repeated keydowns no longer touch the flag.

2. **Focus ring was invisible at full size.** On focus the circle scales up by 5%, which at 360px is 9px per side and covered the 8px gap to the same-coloured outline. The offset is now 12px, so the ring stays separate.

3. **High-contrast shadow never applied.** The `prefers-contrast: more` shadow rule was overridden by the base `svg` rule that came later in the stylesheet. The shadow is now a `--drop` custom property on `:root`, overridden in the high-contrast block.

The pulse animation now uses `--drop` too, so it ends on the correct shadow in high-contrast mode instead of the hardcoded default one.

## Left alone

- **Corner dot:** the small `.color-indicator` is the same colour as the circle and doesn't scale with it on hover, so it adds little. Removing it is a design call, so I kept it.
- **Double announcement:** `aria-describedby` on the button points at the live status region, so some screen readers may read a colour change twice. Dropping `status` from that attribute would fix it, at the cost of not reading the current colour when the button gets focus.
